English: An estimated 851 340 women in Namibia are at risk of human papilloma viral (HPV) infection that may cause cervical cancer.
Luganda: Abakazi nga 851 340 mu Namibia bali mu bulabe bw’okufuna akawuka ka human papilloma virus (HPV) akayinza okuleeta kookolo w’omumwa gwa nnabaana.
Yoruba: Ìṣirò obìnrin 851 340 ní Namibia ni wọ́n wà nínú ewu àìsàn fáírọ́ọ̀sì tí ń ràn nípa ìbálòpọ̀ (HPV) tí ó ń fa jẹjẹrẹ òbò.
Zulu: Balinganiselwa kwaba-851 340 abesifazane base-Namibia abasengcupheni yokutheleleka nge-human papilloma viral (HPV) engase ibangele umdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho.
Hausa: An ƙiyasta mata guda 851 340 a Namibiya suna cikin haɗarin kamuwa da cutar papilloma ta ɗan’adam (HPV) wadda za ta iya haifar da kansar mahaifa.
Northern Sotho: Basadi bao ba balelwago go ba 851 340 ba Namibia ba kotsing ya go swarwa ke phetšo ya human papilloma viral (HPV) yeo e ka bakago kankere ya molomo wa popelo.
Amharic: በናሚቢያ በግምት 851 340 ሴቶች የማህጸን በር ካንሰርን ሊያስከስት የሚችለው የሂዩማን ፓፒሎማ ቫይረስ (ኤችፒቪ) ኢንፌክሽን አደጋ ላይ ናቸው።

English: Visual screening with acetic acid (VIA) and cryotherapy have been proven highly effective.
Luganda: Okukebera okw’okukozesa amaaso ne acetic acid (VIA) awamu ne cryotherapy kwakakasibwa ng’okukola ennyo.
Yoruba: Àyẹ̀wò pẹ̀lú ojú àti ásíìdì àsẹ́tíìkì (VIA) àti ìtọ́jú àìlera nípa ìgbésẹ̀ ajẹmọ́-òtútù ti fi hàn pé ó múná dóko.
Zulu: Ukuhlolwa okubonakalayo nge-acetic acid (VIA) kanye ne-cryotherapy kuhlolwe ukuthi kusebenza kahle kakhulu.
Hausa: Binciken gani tare da sinadarin ruwan kal (VIA) da cryotherapy an tabbatar da tasiri sosai.
Northern Sotho: Tlhahlobo ya tebeledišišo ka esiti ya asetiki (VIA) le khraotherapi go hlatseditšwe gore e šoma ka tshwanelo kudu.
Amharic: በአሴቲክ አሲድ የተደረገ የቪዥዋል ማጣራት (VIA) እና ክሪዮህክምና እጅግ ውጤታማ እንደሆኑ ተረጋግጧል።

English: However, data associating with the impact of cervical cancer screening programmes lack.
Luganda: Wabula, tewali bubaka bukwata ku bireetebwa enkebera za kookolo w’omumwa gwa nnabaana.
Yoruba: Síbẹ̀síbẹ̀, dátà tó níṣẹ pẹ̀lú ipa tí àwọn ìpéjọpọ̀ àyẹ̀wò jẹjẹrẹ òbò ò ní.
Zulu: Nokho, ulwazi oluhlotshaniswa nomthelela wezinhlelo zokuhlola umdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho alukho.
Hausa: Ko ta yaya, an rasa bayanan da suke da alaƙa da tasirin shirye-shiryen tantance cutar kansar mahaifa
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjalo, datha ye e amanago le kamego ya mananeo a tlhahlobo ya kankere ya molomo wa popelo e a hlokega.
Amharic: ነገር ግን፣ የማህጸን በር ካንሰር ማጣሪያ ፕሮግራሞች ጋር የሚያያዙ መረጃዎች ይጎድላቸዋል።

English: This study evaluated visual and cytology screening in preventing cervical intraepithelial lesions (CIN) and cervical cancer in Namibia.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kwekenneenya enkebera y’okukozesa amaaso n’ey’obutaffaali mu kulwanyisa ebiwundu by’omu nnabaana ne kookolo w’omumwa gwa nnabaana mu Namibia.
Yoruba: Iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí ṣe àgbéyẹ̀wò àyẹ̀wò pẹ̀lú ojú lásán àti àyẹ̀wò irúfẹ́ sẹ́ẹ̀lì kan nípa ìdádúró ọgbẹ́ inú òbò (CIN) àti jẹjẹrẹ òbò ní Namibia.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo luhlole ukuhlolwa okubonakalayo kanye nokuhlola kwe-cytology ekuvimbeleni izilonda ze-cervical intraepithelial leisons (CIN) kanye nomdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho e-Namibia.
Hausa: Wannan binciken ya kimanta binciken gani da cytology a cikin hana cututtukan intraepithelial na mahaifa (CIN) da kuma kansar mahaifa a ƙasar Namibiya.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše di lekotše tlhahlobo ya tebeledišišo le thutasele go thibeleng ga cervical intraepithelial lesions (CIN) le kankere ya molomo wa popelo ka Namibia.
Amharic: ይህ ጥናት በናሚቢያ የሰርቪካል ካንሰርን እና የማህጸን በር ኢንትራፒቴሊያ ቁስሎችን (CIN) ለመከላከል የቪዥዋል እና የሳይቶሎጂ ማጣራትን ገምግሟል።

English: Findings showed that women with HPV, cervicitis, koilocytosis and atypia are at an increased risk of testing positive for VIA.
Luganda: Ebyazuulibwa byalaga nti abakazi abalina HPV, cervicitis, koilocytosis ne atypia bali mu bulabe bwa maanyi obw’okusangibwa ne VIA.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí fi hàn pé àwọn obìnrin tí wọ́n ní HPV, ọgbẹ́ òbò, kóílósẹ́tóòsì àti ségesège sẹ́ẹ̀lì wà ní èwù tó pọ̀ nípa pé wọ́n lè ní VIA lára.
Zulu: Okutholakele kubonise ukuthi abesifazane abane-HPV, i-cervicitis, i-koilocytosis kanye ne-atypia basengozini eyengeziwe yokuhlolelwa ukuthi bane-VIA.
Hausa: Bincike ya nuna cewa matan da suke da cutar HPV, cervicitis, koilocytosis da atypia suna cikin haɗarin gwajin nuna kamuwa da VIA.
Northern Sotho: Dikutollo di laeditše gore basadi bao ba nago le HPV, cervicitis, koilocytosis le atypia ba kotsing e kgolo ya go hwetšwa ba na le phetetšo ya VIA.
Amharic: ግኝቶቹ እንዳሳዩት ኤችፒቪ፣ ሰርቪሳይተስ፣ ኮይሎሳይቶሲስ እና አቲይፒያ ያለባቸው ሴቶች ለVIA ፖዘቲቭ የመሆን ከፍተኛ አደጋ ላይ ናቸው።

English: Older women, particularly with HIV are more likely to be diagnosed with squamous cell carcinoma (SCC).
Luganda: Abakazi abakuze mu myaka, naddala nga balina HIV basuubirwa nnyo okusangibwa ne squamous cell carcinoma (SCC).
Yoruba: Àwọn àgbà obìnrin ,àgàgà àwọn tí wọ́n ní HIV lè ní ìdámọ̀ àìsàn jẹjẹrẹ àwọ̀ ara (SCC).
Zulu: Abesifazane asebekhulile, ikakhulukazi abane-HIV maningi amathuba okuthi batholakale bene-squamous cell carcinoma (SCC).
Hausa: Mata tsofaffi, musamman masu ɗauke da cutar HIV sun fi fuskantar kamuwa da ƙuraje (SCC).
Northern Sotho: Basadi ba bagolo, kudukudu bao ba nago le HIV go na le kgonagalo ye ntši ya gore ge ba phekolwa go hwetšwe ba na le squamous cell carcinoma (SCC).
Amharic: በተለይም ኤችአይቪ ያለባቸው በእድሜ የገፉ ሴቶች በስኳመስ ሴል ካርሲኖማ (ስ.ሴ.ካ) የመያዝ እድላቸው ከፍተኛ ነው።

English: VIA procedure seems to be viable in screening, although colposcopy in patient follow-up in the Namibian context should be revised and used with positive HR-HPV results.
Luganda: Enkebera ey’okukozesa amaaso erabika ng’ekola bulungi, newankubadde colposcopy mu kulondoola abalwadde mu Namibia esaanye okutereezebwamu ekozesebwe mu abo abasangiddwa ne HR-HPV.
Yoruba: Ìgbésẹ̀ VIA fẹ́ ẹ̀ lè yanjú àyẹ̀wò, ṣùgbọ́n àyẹ̀wò àìsàn ajẹmọ́ òbò ní ìtọ́jú aláìsàn nínú ìṣẹ̀tò Namibia gbọ́dọ̀ di àtúngbéyẹ̀wò, tí wọ́n sì gbọ́dọ̀ lò pẹ̀lú èsì ìdánwò àwọn tí wọ́n ní HR-HPV.
Zulu: Inqubo ye-VIA ibonakala isebenza ekuhlolweni, nakuba i-colposcopy ekulandeleni isiguli esimweni sase-Namibia kufanele ibuyekezwe futhi isetshenziswe ngemiphumela emihle ye-HR-HPV.
Hausa: Hanyar VIA da alama tana da amfani a cikin dubawa, ko da yake ya kamata a sake duba aikin binciken ga marasa lafiya a cikin mahallin Namibiya kuma a yi amfani da shi tare da sakamako mai kyau na HR-HPV.
Northern Sotho: Tshepedišo ya VIA e bonala e ka ba mohola tabeng ya go sekerina, le ge e le gore tlhahlobo ya setho sa bosadi ka setlabela go lekola seemo sa balwetši ka tikologong ya Namibia e swanetše go lekodišišwa gape le go šomišwa ka dipoelo tša go fetelwa ke HR-HPV.
Amharic: የVIA አሰራር ማጣራት ላይ የሚሰራ ይመስላል፣ ነገር ግን በናሚቢያ ገጽታ በህመምተኞች የህክምና ክትትል ላይ ኮልፖስኮፒ መሻሻል እና ከአውንታዊ የHR- ኤችፒቪ ውጤቶች ጋር ጥቅም ላይ መዋል አለበት።

English: Screening modalities incorporating HPV testing for different ages and risk populations (e.g. HIV positive, autoimmune disease) is recommended.
Luganda: Bawagira enkebera ezirimu okukebera HPV mu bantu ab’emyaka egy’enjawulo ne mu bantu abangu b’okufuna kookolo (okugeza abalina HIV, obulwadde obulimu obusibage okulumba obutaffaali obulamu).
Yoruba: Àbá ìlò ìgbésẹ̀ àyẹ̀wò tí ó ń ṣàmúlò àyẹ̀wò HPV fún oríṣiríṣi ọjọ́ orí àti ewu ti ọ̀pọ̀ ènìyàn (e.g. àwọn tí wọ́n ní HIV, àìsàn tí ń jẹ́ kí ara ṣiṣẹ́ sódì) wà nílẹ̀.
Zulu: Izindlela zokuhlola ezihlanganisa ukuhlolelwa i-HPV ubudala obuhlukahlukene kanye nenani labantu abasengozini (isb. ukuba ne-HIV, isifo sokuzivikela komzimba) kuyanconywa.
Hausa: An shawarta hanyoyin nunawa da suka haɗa da gwajin cutar HPV na shekaru daban-daban da kuma yawan haɗarin (misali mai cutar HIV, cututtuka masu afkawa garkuwar jiki).
Northern Sotho: Go šišinywa gore go be le mekgwa ya tlhahlobo ye e akaretšago go dira diteko tša HPV go batho ba mengwaga ye e fapafapanego le bao ba lego kotsing (mohlala, bao ba nago le phetetšo ya HIV, ba bolwetši bja go itlhasela ga mašole a mmele).
Amharic: ለተለያዩ እድሜዎች እና አደጋ ላይ ላሉ ህዝቦች (ለምሳሌ ኤችአይቪ ፖዘቲቭ፣ አውቶኢሚዩን በሽታ) የኤችፒቪ ምርመራን የሚያካትቱ ዘዴዎችን ይመከራሉ።

English: Screening uptake can further be improved by interventions that adopt a model which uses previous diagnostic outcomes, women’s health objectives, up-to-date knowledge and practice relevant to national context.
Luganda: Okwettanira okwekebeza kusobola okwongerwamu amaanyi nga wateereddwawo kaweefube alimu okukozesa enkola ekozesa ebyava mu kukebera okw’emabega, ebigendererwa by’abakazi eby’ebyobulamu, obubaka obupya n’okukola ebyo ebituukana n’embeera y’eggwanga.
Yoruba: Ìlọsíwájú tún lè bá ìṣàmúlò àyẹ̀wò nípa ìlọ́wọ́sí tí ó gba módẹ́ẹ̀lì tí ó ń lo ìdámọ̀ àìsàn ti tẹ́lẹ̀, èrò ìlera àwọn obìnrin, ìmọ̀ tó péye àti ṣíṣe iṣẹ́ tí ó yẹ, tí ó sì yẹ sí orílẹ̀-èdè.
Zulu: Ukusetshenziswa kokuhlolwa kungathuthukiswa ngokuqhubekayo ngokungenelela okusebenzisa imodeli esebenzisa imiphumela yangaphambilini yokuxilonga, izinhloso zezempilo zabesifazane, ulwazi lwakamuva kanye nokwenza okufanele kumongo kazwelonke.
Hausa: Za a iya ƙara haɓaka aikin tantancewa ta hanyar amfani da tsarin da ke amfani da sakamakon bincike na baya, manufofin lafiyar mata, ilimin zamani da aikin da ya dace da yanayin ƙasa.
Northern Sotho: Go oketša palo ya tlhahlobo go ka kaonafatšwa ka maitekelo ao a šomišago mmotlolo wo o šomišago dipoelo tša peleng tša phekolo, dinepo tša maphelo tša basadi, tsebo ye e sepelago le mabaka le boitlwaetšo bjo bo sepelelanago le ditiragalo tša ka nageng.
Amharic: የማጣራት ሂደቱ ከዛሬ በፊት የተደረጉ የምርመራ ውጤቶችን ጥቅም ላይ የሚያውል የጣልቃገብነት ሞዴልን በመጠቀም፣ የሴቶች የጤና አላማዎችን ፣ የዘመነ እውቀትን እና ከሃገሩ ነባራዊ ገጽታ ጋር የሚሄዱ ልምምዶችን በመጠቀም የበለጠ ማሻሻል ይችላል።

English: Many tests can show women’s risk for cervical cancer, but routine check-ups in Namibia don’t always use these tests.
Luganda: Enkola z’okukebera nnyingi zisobola okulaga obulabe bw’abakazi obw’okufuna kookolo w’omumwa gwa nnabaana, naye mu kukebera okw’ebiseera ebigere mu Namibia enkola zino tezitera kukozesebwa.
Yoruba: Ọ̀pọ̀ àyẹ̀wò máa ń ṣàfihàn ewu tí obìnrin wà fún jẹjẹrẹ òbò ṣùgbọ́n àyẹ̀wò àtìgbàdégbà ní Namibia ò kí ń lo àwọn àyẹ̀wò yìí.
Zulu: Ukuhlola okuningi kungabonisa ingozi yabesifazane yomdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho, kodwa ukuhlola okuvamile e-Namibia akusebenzisi njalo lokhu kuhlola.
Hausa: Yawancin gwaje-gwaje na iya nuna haɗarin mata don kamuwa da cutar kansar mahaifa, amma binciken yau da kullum a ƙasar Namibiya ba sa amfani da waɗannan gwaje-gwajen.
Northern Sotho: Diteko tše ntši di ka bontšha kotsi ya kankere ya molomo wa popelo go basadi, eupša diteko tša nako le nako go la Namibia ga di šomiše diteko tše ka mehla.
Amharic: ብዙ ምርመራዎች ሴቶች ለማህጸን በር ካንሰር አደጋ ላይ እንደሆኑ ያሳያሉ፣ ነገር ግን በናሚቢያ የሚደረጉ መደበኛ ምርመራዎች ሁሌ እነዚህ ምርመራዎች ጥቅም ላይ መዋላችውን አያሳዩም።

English: Researchers suggest regular testing, to find warning signs earlier, could prevent women from developing this deadly disease.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bagamba nti okukebera mu biseera ebigere, okuzuula obubonero obubaguliza nga bukyali, kisobola okutaasa abakazi okufuna obulwadde buno obw’obulabe.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí dábàá àyẹ̀wò lóòrèkóòrè, láti lè tètè rí àwọn àmì ìkìlọ̀ yìí, láti lè dẹ́kun bí àwọn obìnrin ṣe ń ní àrùn tí ń pa èèyàn yìí.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baphakamise ukuhlola okuvamile, ukuze kutholakale izimpawu eziyisixwayiso kusenesikhathi, kungavimbela abesifazane ekubeni babe nalesi sifo esibulalayo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun bayar da shawarar yin gwaji akai-akai, don gano alamun gargaɗi tun da farko, yana iya hana mata kamuwa da wannan cuta mai saurin kisa.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba šišinya gore go dirwe diteko tša nako le nako, go hwetša maswao a temošo e sa le nako, go ka thibela basadi gore ba se hlaselwe ke bolwetši bjo bjo šoro.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች መደበኛ ምርመራዎችን ማድረግ አስጊ ምልክቶችን አስቀድሞ ለማግኘት ይመክራሉ፤ ይህም ሴቶች ገዳዩን በሽታ ከመያዝ ሊያድናቸው ይችላል።

English: Cervical cancer (cancer of the lower section of the womb) causes many deaths among women world-wide.
Luganda: Kookolo w’omumwa gwa nnabaana (kookolo w’ekitundu kya nnabaana ekya wansi) atta abakazi bangi okwetooloola ensi.
Yoruba: Jẹjẹrẹ òbò (jẹjẹrẹ tí ó máa ń mú èèyàn ní ìsàlẹ̀ ilé ọmọ) máa ń fa ikú púpọ̀ láàárín àwọn obìnrin kárí ayé.
Zulu: Umdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho (umdlavuza wengxenye engezansi yesibeletho) ubangela ukufa kwabantu abaningi kwabesifazane emhlabeni wonke.
Hausa: Kansar mahaifa (kansar ƙasan mahaifa) yana haifar da mutuwar mata da yawa a duk duniya.
Northern Sotho: Kankere ya molomo wa popelo (kankere ya karolo ya ka fasana ga popelo) e baka mahu a mantši magareng ga basadi lefaseng ka bophara.
Amharic: ሰርቪካል ካንሰር (የማህጸን የታችኛው ክፍል ካንሰር) በአለም ዙሪያ የብዙ ሴቶችን ህይወት ይቀጥፋል።

English: One of the most common causes of cervical cancer is Human Papillomavirus, or HPV.
Luganda: Ekimu ku bisinga okulwaza kookolo w’omumwa gwa nnabaana ke kawuka akayitibwa Human Papillomavirus, oba HPV.
Yoruba: Ọ̀kan lára àwọn okùnfà jẹjẹrẹ òbò tó wọ́pọ̀ jù ni fáírọ̀ọ̀sì tí ń ràn nípa ìbálópọ̀ tàbí HPV.
Zulu: Enye yezimbangela ezivame kakhulu zomdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho yi-Human Papillomavirus, noma i-HPV.
Hausa: Ɗaya daga cikin abubuwan da suke haifar da kansar mahaifa shi ne Fafilobairas na Ɗan’adam, ko HPV.
Northern Sotho: Ye nngwe ya tšeo go tlwaelegilego gore di baka kankere ya molomo wa popelo ke Human Papillomavirus, goba HPV.
Amharic: አንዱ ዋንኛ የማህጸን በር ካንሰር ምክንያት ሂዩማን ፓፒሎማ ቫይረስ ወይም ኤችፒቪ ነው።

English: HPV is a virus that damages the cells of the womb, forming wounds called lesions, which can eventually become cancerous.
Luganda: HPV kawuka akakosa obutaffaali bwa nnabaana, ne kireetawo ebiwundu, oluvannyuma ebisobola okuvaamu kookolo.
Yoruba: HPV jẹ́ fáírọ̀ọ̀sì tí ń ba àwọn sẹ́ẹ̀lì ilé ọmọ jẹ́, tí ń fa àwọn ọgbẹ́ tí wọ́n ń pè ní egbò, tí ó lè padà fa jẹjẹrẹ.
Zulu: I-HPV igciwane elilimaza imithambo yesibeletho, lakhe izilonda ezibizwa ngokuthi i-leisons, ezingagcina zibe nomdlavuza.
Hausa: Cutar HPV ƙwayar cuta ce da take lalata ƙwayoyin mahaifa, ta haifar da raunuka, wanda a ƙarshe za su iya zama kansa.
Northern Sotho: HPV ke baerase yeo e senyago disele tša popelo, ya bopa dišo tše di bitšwago mabadi, tšeo mafelelong di ka bakago kankere e šoro kudu.
Amharic: ኤችፒቪ የማህጸንን ሴሎች የሚጎዳ ቫይረስ ሲሆን፣ በጊዜ ብዛት ወደ ካንሰር ሊቀየሩ የሚችሉ ሊዬዞኖች የሚባሉ ቁሰሎችን ያስከስታል።

English: Though a vaccine to prevent HPV exists, many women in African countries, including Namibia, don’t have access to it.
Luganda: Newankubadde ng’eddagala erigema HPV weeriri, abakazi bangi mu mawanga ga Africa, nga ne Namibia mw’ogitwalidde, tebasobola kulifuna.
Yoruba: Bó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé àjẹsára wà láti dènà HPV, ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn obìnrin ní àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè ti Áfíríkà, tí Namibia jẹ́ ọ̀kan lára rẹ̀, ò ni ní àrọ́wọ́tó.
Zulu: Nakuba umgomo wokuvimbela i-HPV ukhona, abesifazane abaningi emazweni ase-Afrika, kuhlanganise ne-Namibia, abakwazi ukufinyelela kuwo.
Hausa: Ko da yake akwai maganin rigakafi domin hana cutar HPV, mata da yawa a cikin ƙasashen Afirka, ciki har da ƙasar Namibiya, ba su da damar yin amfani da shi.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go na le moento wa go thibela HPV, bontši bja basadi ka dinageng tša Afrika, go akaretša Namibia, ga ba kgone go o fihlelela.
Amharic: ኤችፒቪን ለመከላከል የሚጠቅም ክትባት ያለ ቢሆንም፣ ብዙ አፍሪካ ውስጥ ናሚቢያን ጨምሮ የሚገኙ ሴቶች ሊያገኙት አይችሉም።

English: This means that checking for the virus or the lesions it causes is especially important for these women, as it is the best way to help prevent cancer.
Luganda: Kino kitegeeza nti okukebera akawuka oba ebiwundu bye kaleeta kya mugaso nnyo eri abakazi bano, kubanga ye ngeri esinga obulungi ey’okuyamba okwewala kookolo.
Yoruba: Èyí túmọ̀ sí pé, ṣíṣe àyẹ̀wò fún fáírọ̀ọ̀sì tàbí egbò tí ó ń fà jẹ́ kókó fún àwọn obìnrin wọ̀nyí, tí ó sì jẹ́ ọ̀nà tí ó dára jù láti dènà jẹjẹrẹ.
Zulu: Lokhu kusho ukuthi ukuhlola igciwane noma izilonda elizibangelayo kubaluleke kakhulu kulaba besifazane, njengoba kuyindlela engcono kakhulu yokusiza ukuvimbela umdlavuza.
Hausa: Wannan yana nufin bincikar ƙwayar cutar ko raunukan da take haifarwa yana da mahimmanci musamman ga waɗannan mata, domin ita ce hanya mafi dacewa don rigakafin cutar kansa.
Northern Sotho: Se se šupa gore go dira diteko tša baerase goba mabadi tšeo e di hlolago go tloga go le bohlokwa go basadi ba, ka ge e le tsela ye kaonekaone go thuša go thibela kankere.
Amharic: ይህ ማለት በተለይም ለእነዚህ ሴቶች ካንሰሩን ለመከላከል ምርጡ መንገድ ስለሆነ፣ ቫይረሱ ወይም ሊዬዞኖቹ መኖራቸውን መፈተሽ እጅግ ወሳኝ ነው።

English: The researchers in this study say that hospitals therefore need proper guidelines and information about the best tests to use.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza mu kunoonyereza kuno bagamba nti noolwekyo amalwaliro geetaaga ebigobererwa ebituufu n’obubaka ebikwata ku nkola z’okukebera ezisinga obulungi.
Yoruba: Awọ̀n aṣèwádìí iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí sọ pé àwọn ilé ìwòsàn ní láti ní àwọn ìlànà tó péye àti àlàyé lórí àwọn àyẹ̀wò tó dára jù láti lò.
Zulu: Abacwaningi kulolu cwaningo bathi ngakho-ke izibhedlela zidinga imihlahlandlela efanele nolwazi mayelana nokuhlolwa okungcono kakhulu okumele kusetshenziswe.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce saboda haka asibitoci suna buƙatar ingantattun jagorori da bayanai game da mafi kyawun gwaje-gwajen da za a yi amfani da su.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ka dinyakišišong tše ba bolela gore dipetlele di hloka ditlhahli tša maleba le tshedimošo mabapi le diteko tše kaonekaone tše di ka šomišwago.
Amharic: የዚህ ጥናት ተመራማሪዎች እንደሚሉት ስለዚህ ሆስፒታሎች የትኛውን ምርጥ ምርመራ መጠቀም እነዳለባቸው እንዲያውቁ ትክክለኛ መመሪያዎች እና መረጃዎች ያስፈልጓቸዋል።

English: They add that medical staff also need more information about how factors like age or health affect a woman’s risk of getting HPV and cancer.
Luganda: Bongerako nti abasawo nabo beetaaga okumanya ebisingawo ku ngeri ebintu nga emyaka oba embeera y’obulamu gye biyinza okuviirako omukazi okufuna HPV ne kookolo.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣàfíkún pé àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ oníṣègùn òyìnbó tún nílò àlàyé kíkún si lórí bí àwọn nǹkan bíi ọjọ́ orí àti ìlera ṣe ń nípá lórí ewu obìnrin láti ní HPV àti jẹjẹrẹ.
Zulu: Bengeza ngokuthi abasebenzi bezokwelapha badinga ulwazi olwengeziwe mayelana nokuthi izici ezifana neminyaka noma impilo ziyithinta kanjani ingozi yowesifazane yokuthola i-HPV nomdlavuza.
Hausa: Sun kuma ƙara da cewa ma’aikatan kiwon lafiya suna buƙatar ƙarin bayani game da yadda abubuwa kamar shekaru ko lafiya ke shafar haɗarin mace na kamuwa da cutar HPV da kuma kansa.
Northern Sotho: Ba tlaleletša ka gore bašomedi ba tša kalafo le bona ba hloka tshedimošo ka botlalo mabapi le gore dintlha tše bjalo ka mengwaga goba maphelo di ama bjang kotsi ya mosadi ya go fetelwa ke HPV le kankere.
Amharic: እንዲሁም የህክምና ሰራተኞቹ እንደ እድሜ እና ጤና ያሉ ምክንያቶች ሴቶች ኤችፒቪ እና ካንሰር የመያዛቸው አደጋ ላይ እንዴት ተጽእኖ እንደሚያደርጉ ለማወቅ ተጨማሪ መረጃ ያስፈልጋችዋል ብለዋል።

English: They investigated how effective some common types of tests (called screening methods) were for finding HPV and lesions.
Luganda: Beetegereza enkola y’ezimu ku nkebera ezitera okukozesebwa mu kuzuula HPV n’ebiwundu.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe ìwádìí lórí bí àwọn irúfẹ́ àyẹ̀wò kan ṣe ń ṣiṣẹ́ sí (tí wọ́n pè ní àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ àyẹ̀wò) tí wọ́n fi ń ṣàwárí HPV àti egbò.
Zulu: Baphenye ukuthi zisebenza kanjani ezinye izinhlobo ezijwayelekile zokuhlola (okuthiwa izindlela zokuhlola) bekungezokuthola i-HPV nezilonda.
Hausa: Sun binciki yadda tasirin wasu nau’o’in gwaje-gwaje na yau da kullum (wanda ake kira hanyoyin dubawa) suka kasance domin gano cutar HPV da raunuka.
Northern Sotho: Ba dirile dinyakišišo mabapi le ka moo mehuta ye mengwe ye e tlwaelegilego ya diteko e šomilego gabotse ka gona (ye e bitšwago mekgwa ya tlhahlobo) go utolleng HPV le mabadi.
Amharic: የተለመዱ የምርመራ አይነቶች (የማጣሪያ ዘዴዎች) በመባል የሚታወቁት ኤችፒቪን እና ሊዬዞኖችን ለማግኘት ምን ያህል ውጤታማ እንደሆኑ መርምረዋል።

English: They were also interested in comparing screening methods, for example collecting cells from the womb to check for damage compared to just looking for lesions.
Luganda: Era baali baagala okugeraageranya enkebera, okugeza okuggya obutaffaali mu nnabaana okukebera oba buliko obuvune bw’ogeraageranya n’okunoonya obunoonya ebiwundu.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún ni lọ́kàn láti se àfiwéra àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ àyẹ̀wò, fún àpẹẹrẹ, gbígba àwọn sẹ́ẹ̀lì láti ilé ọmọ láti wò ó fún ìpalára tó wà yàtọ̀ sí wíwá egbò lásán lọ.
Zulu: Baphinde babe nentshisekelo yokuqhathanisa izindlela zokuhlola, isibonelo ukuqoqa amaseli esibelethweni ukuze ahlole umonakalo uma kuqhathaniswa nokubheka izilonda nje.
Hausa: Suna kuma sha'awar kwatanta hanyoyin tantancewa, misali tattara ƙwayoyin mahaifa don bincikar lalacewa idan aka kwatanta da neman raunuka kawai.
Northern Sotho: Gape ba bile le kgahlego ya go bapetša mekgwa ya tlhahlobo, mohlala, go hwetša disele go tšwa popelong go lekola tshenyo ge go bapetšwa le go nyakana fela le mabadi.
Amharic: እንዲሁም የማጣሪያ ዘዴዎችን ለማወዳደር ፍላጎቱ ነበራቸው፤ ለምሳሌ ዝምብሎ ሊዬዞኖችን ከመፈለግ ይልቅ ከማህጸን ላይ ሴሎችን በመሰብሰብ ጉዳትን መፈተሽ ።

English: They also wanted to know whether differences between women, like their age, or whether they had other diseases like HIV, changed their chances of getting HPV and cancer.
Luganda: Era baayagala okumanya oba ng’enjawulo wakati w’abakazi, ng’emyaka gyabwe, oba okubeera n’endwadde endala nga HIV, kikyusa ku bulabe bwabwe obw’okufuna HPV ne kookolo.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún fẹ́ mọ̀ bóyá ìyàtọ̀ wà láàárín àwọn obìnrin yìí, bí ọjọ́ orí, àbí wọ́ni ní àwọn àrùn míràn bí HIV, ló fa àyípadà tí ó wà lórí bí wọ́n ṣe ní HPV àti jẹjẹrẹ sí.
Zulu: Baphinde bafuna ukwazi ukuthi ngabe umehluko phakathi kwabesifazane, njengeminyaka yabo, noma ukuthi banezinye izifo ezifana ne-HIV, wawashintsha yini amathuba okuthola i-HPV nomdlavuza.
Hausa: Sun kuma so su san ko bambance-bambancen da yake tsakanin mata, kamar shekarunsu, ko kuma suna da wasu cututtuka kamar HIV, sun canza damarsu ta kamuwa da cutar HPV da kuma kansa.
Northern Sotho: Ba be ba nyaka le go tseba ge e ba go fapafapana magareng ga basadi, go swana le mengwaga ya bona, goba ge e ba bile le malwetši a mangwe a bjalo ka HIV, tšeo di fetotšego dibaka tša bona tša go fetelwa ke HPV le kankere.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም በሴቶች መካከል የሚከሰቱ እንደ እድሜያቸው እና እንደ ኤችአይቪ አይነት ሌሎች በሽታዎች ኖሮባቸው ማወቁ አይነት ልዩነቶች በኤችፒቪ ወይም በካንሰር የመያዝ አዝማሚያቸውን ይቀይረው እንደሆነ ማወቅ ፈልገው ነበር።

English: Knowing this information could help hospitals and clinics use screening methods more effectively.
Luganda: Okumanya obubaka buno kiyinza okuyamba amalwaliro ne kkiriniki okukozesa obulungi enkola z’okukebera.
Yoruba: Mímọ àwọn àlàyé yìí lè ran àwọn ilé ìwòsàn àti àwọn ilé ìtọ́jú lọ́wọ́ dáadáa lórí àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ àyẹ̀wò.
Zulu: Ukwazi lolu lwazi kungasiza izibhedlela nemitholampilo ukuthi isebenzise izindlela zokuhlola ngempumelelo.
Hausa: Sanin wannan bayanin zai iya taimaka wa asibitoci da ƙananan asibitoci su yi amfani da hanyoyin tantancewa sosai.
Northern Sotho: Go tseba tshedimošo ye go ka thuša dipetlele le dikliniki go šomiša mekgwa ya tlhahlobo ka tshwanelo.
Amharic: ይህን መረጃ ማወቃቸው ሆስፒታሎች እና ክሊኒኮች የማጣሪያ ዘዴዎችን በበለጠ ውጤታማነት እነዲጠቀሙ ሊያግዛቸው ይችላል።

English: The researchers looked at patient records for 214 women who had been screened and treated for HPV, lesions, and cervical cancer at a hospital in Windhoek, Namibia.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baatunuulira ebiwandiiko by’abalwadde eby’abakazi 214 abaakeberwa ne bajjanjabwa HPV, ebiwundu, ne kookolo w’omumwa gwa nnabaana mu ddwaliro mu Windhoek, Namibia.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí wo àwọn àkọsílẹ̀ obìnrin aláìsàn 214 tí wọ́n ti yẹ̀wò àti tọ́jú fún HIV, egbò àti jẹjẹrẹ òbò ní ilé ìwòsàn kan ní Windhoek, Namibia.
Zulu: Abacwaningi babheke amarekhodi eziguli kwabesifazane abangama-214 abahlolelwe futhi belashelwa i-HPV, izilonda, nomdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho esibhedlela e-Windhoek, e-Namibia.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun duba bayanan marasa lafiya na mata guda 214 da aka yi musu gwajin cutar HPV, raunuka, da kansar mahaifa a wani asibiti a Windhoek, ƙasar Namibiya.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba lebeletše direkote tša balwetši tša basadi ba 214 bao ba bego ba dirilwe ditlhahlobo ebile ba alafetšwe HPV, mabadi, le kankere ya molomo wa popelo sepetlele go la Windhoek, Namibia.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ለኤችፒቪ፣ ሊዬዞኖች እና ለሰርቪካል ካንሰር በዊንድሆክ ናሚቢያ ሆስፒታል የተጣሩ እና የታከሙ የ214 በሽተኛ ሴቶችን ሪኮረዶች አይተው ነበር።

English: They focused specifically on early-stage cervical cancer, which is when the disease can be treated more easily and effectively.
Luganda: Okusinga essira baalissa ku kookolo w’omumwa gwa nnabaana ow’oku mutendera ogusooka, nga wano obulwadde buno buba busobola okujjanjabwa obulungi.
Yoruba: Àfojúsùn wọn gan ní pàtó ni ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ jẹjẹrẹ òbò, tí ó sì jẹ́ ìgbà tí wọ́n ṣì lè tọ́jú àìsàn náà lẹ́rọ̀ àti dáadáa.
Zulu: Bagxile kakhulu kumdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho osaqala, okuyilapho lesi sifo singelapheka kalula nangempumelelo.
Hausa: Sun mai da hankali musamman kan kansar mahaifa a farkon matakin, wanda shi ne lokacin da za a iya magance cutar cikin sauƙi da kuma inganci.
Northern Sotho: Ba beile šedi ye kgolo go kankere ya molomo wa popelo ye e lemogilwego ka pela, e lego ge bolwetši bo ka alafša gabonolo kudu le ka tshwanelo.
Amharic: በተለይም በሽታው በቀላሉ እና ውጤታማ በሆነ መልኩ መታከም በሚችልበት በመጀመሪያ ደረጃ በሚገኝ የማህጸን በር ካንሰር ላይ አተኩረዋል።

English: They also collected information about each woman’s age, and her general health.
Luganda: Era baakuŋŋaanya obubaka obukwata ku buli myaka gya mukazi, n’embeera y’obulamu bwabwe ey’awamu.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún gba àwọn àlàyé sílẹ̀ lórí ọjọ́ orí obìnrin kọ̀ọ̀kan àti ìlera rẹ̀.
Zulu: Baphinde baqoqa ulwazi mayelana neminyaka yowesifazane ngamunye, kanye nempilo yakhe jikelele.
Hausa: Sun kuma tattara bayanai game da shekarun kowace mace, da kuma lafiyarta gabaɗaya.
Northern Sotho: Ba kgobokeditše le tshedimošo ya mengwaga ya mosadi o mongwe le o mongwe, le seemo sa gagwe sa maphelo ka kakaretšo.
Amharic: ስለ እያንዳንዷ ሴት እድሜ እና አጠቃላይ የጤና ሁኔታ መረጃም ሰብስበዋል።

English: By reviewing these records, they found that different screening techniques often gave medical staff different information, and that they might be more useful before or after HPV had developed into cancer.
Luganda: Mu kwetegereza ebiwandiiko bino, baakizuula nti enkebera ez’enjawulo zaawanga abasawo obubaka obw’enjawulo, era nti ziyinza okuba ez’omugaso ennyo nga HPV tannafuuka kookolo oba ng’amaze okufuuka.
Yoruba: Nípa ṣíṣe àgbéyẹ̀wò àwọn àkọsílẹ̀ yìí, wọ́n ri pé oríṣiríṣi ìgbésẹ̀ àyẹ̀wò máa ń fún àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ oníṣègùn òyìnbó ní oríṣiríṣi àlàyé, tí ó lè wúlò nígbà àti lẹ́yìn ti HPV bá ti di jẹjẹrẹ.
Zulu: Ngokubuyekeza la marekhodi, bathole ukuthi izindlela ezihlukene zokuhlola ngokuvamile zinikeza izisebenzi zezokwelapha ulwazi oluhlukile, nokuthi zingase zibe usizo kakhulu ngaphambi noma ngemva kokuba i-HPV ikhule ibe umdlavuza.
Hausa: Ta hanyar nazarin waɗannan bayanan, sun gano cewa fasahohin tantancewa daban-daban sukan bai wa ma'aikatan kiwon lafiya bayanai daban-daban, kuma suna iya zama da amfani kafin ko bayan HPV ta haɓaka zuwa kansa.
Northern Sotho: Ka go lekodišiša direkote tše, ba hweditše gore mekgwa ye e fapafapanego ya tlhahlobo gantši e fa bašomedi ba kalafo tshedimošo ye e fapafapanego, le gore e ka ba tšwela mohola kudu pele goba morago ga gore HPV e fetoge go ba kankere.
Amharic: እነዚህን ሪኮርዶች በመገምገም የተለያዩ የማጣሪያ ዘዴዎች ለህክምና ባለሞያዎች የተለያዩ መረጃዎችን እንደሰጡ አግኝተዋል፤ እንዲሁም ኤችፒቪ ወደ ካንሰር ከመቀየሩ በፊት ወይም በኋላ የበለጠ ጠቃሚ ሊሆኑ ይችላሉ።

English: Cancer, for example, was often found by collecting and examining womb cells.
Luganda: Okugeza, kookolo yalabibwa nnyo mu kukuŋŋaanya n’okwetegereza obutaffaali bw’omu nnabaana.
Yoruba: Jẹjẹrẹ, fún àpẹerẹ, ó máa ń sábà jẹ́ rírí nípa gbígba àti ṣíṣe àyẹ̀wò sẹ́ẹ̀lì ilé ọmọ.
Zulu: Umdlavuza, isibonelo, wawuvame ukutholakala ngokuqoqa nokuhlola amaseli esibeletho.
Hausa: Alal misali, ana samun kansa ta hanyar tattarawa da bincikar ƙwayoyin mahaifa.
Northern Sotho: Mohlala, kankere gantši e be e hwetšwa ka go hwetšwa le go hlahlobja ga disele tša popelo.
Amharic: ለምሳሌ አብዛኛውን ጊዜ ካንሰር የማህጸን ሴሎችን በመሰብሰብ እና በመመርመር ተገኝቷል።

English: Lesions, however, could often be found just with a visual inspection, using a technique called “visual inspection with acetic acid” (VIA).
Luganda: Wabula, ebiwundu byasinganga kuzuulibwa n’okutunuulirwa n’amaaso, nga bakozesa akakodyo akayitibwa “visual inspection with acetic acid” (VIA).
Yoruba: Egbò, síbẹ̀síbẹ̀, máa ń di rírí pẹ̀lú ojú lásán, pẹ̀lú ìlò ìgbésẹ̀ tí a pè ní “àyẹ̀wò pẹ̀lú ojú lásán pẹ̀lú ásíìdì àsẹ́tíìkì” (VIA).
Zulu: Izilonda, nokho, zazivame ukutholakala ngokuhlola okubukwayo, kusetshenziswa indlela ebizwa ngokuthi “visual inspection with acetic acid” (VIA).
Hausa: Ana iya samun raunuka, duk da haka, sau da yawa kawai tare da dubawa na gani, ta amfani da wata dabara da ake kira “duban gani da sinadarin ruwan kal” (VIA).
Northern Sotho: Mabadi, le ge go le bjalo, gantši a ka lemogwa ka go dira tlhahlobo ka tebeledišišo, go šomišwa mokgwa wo o bitšwago “tlhahlobo ya tebeledišišo ka esiti ya esitiki” (VIA).
Amharic: ነገርግን ሊዬዞኖች “አሴቲክ አሲድን በመጠቀም የተደረገ የቪዥዋል ማጣራት” (VIA) የሚባል ዘዴን ጥቅም ላይ በማዋል አብዛኛውን ጊዜ በእይታ ምርመራ ብቻ ተገኝቷል።

English: The advantage of this technique is that it allows doctors to find lesions quickly and cheaply.
Luganda: Ekirungi ky’enkola eno kwe kuba nti esobozesa abasawo okuzuula ebiwundu amangu ate mu ngeri etali ya buseere.
Yoruba: Ànfàání ìgbésẹ̀ yìí ni pé ó má ń jẹ́ kí àwọn dọ́kítà tètè rí àwọn ọgbẹ́ náà, tí ò sì wọ́n.
Zulu: Inzuzo yale nqubo wukuthi ivumela odokotela ukuthi bathole izilonda ngokushesha ngemali ephansi.
Hausa: Amfanin wannan dabarar ita ce ta ba wa likitoci damar gano raunuka cikin sauri da kuma arha.
Northern Sotho: Mohola wa mokgwa wo ke gore o thuša dingaka go lemoga mabadi ka lebelo ebile ga o hloke tšhelete ye ntši.
Amharic: የዚህ ቴክኒክ ጥቅም ዶክተሮች ሊዬዞኖችን በርካሽ እና በፍጥነት እንዲያገኙ ማገዙ ነው።

English: This is because it uses basic medical equipment already used for women’s gynaecological examinations, like a speculum (a metal instrument used to look inside the vagina).
Luganda: Kino kiri bwekityo kubanga ekozesa ebyuma by’ekisawo ebyangu ebikozesebwa bulijjo mu kukebera endwadde z’abakazi, nga speculum (ekyuma ekikozesebwa okutunula munda mu bukyala).
Yoruba: Èyí ń wáyé nítorí pé ó máa ń ṣàmúlò àwọn irinṣẹ́ ìṣewòsàn pẹ́pẹ̀pẹ́ kan tí wọ́n má ń lò fún àyẹ̀wò ajẹmọ́-ìtọ́ju ara obìnrin fún àwọn obìnrin bí sípẹ́kílọ́ọ̀mù (irinṣẹ́ onírin kan tí wọ́n ma fí ń wo inú òbò).
Zulu: Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi isebenzisa imishini yezokwelapha eyisisekelo kakade esetshenziselwe ukuhlolwa kwezifo zabesifazane, njenge-speculum (insimbi esetshenziswa ukubheka ngaphakathi esithweni sangasese).
Hausa: Wannan saboda yana amfani da kayan aikin likita na yau da kullun da aka riga aka yi amfani da su domin gwaje-gwajen lafiyar mata, kamar na’urar buɗe farji (kayan ƙarfe da ake amfani da shi domin duba cikin farji).
Northern Sotho: Ke ba baka la gore e šomiša ditlabela tša kalafo tša motheo tše di šomišwago ditlhahlobong tša basadi tša nakong ya boimana, go swana le speculum (setlabela sa metale se se šomišwago go lebelela ka gare ga setho sa bosadi).
Amharic: ይህ የሆነበት ምክንያት አሁንም ጥቅም ላይ እየዋለ ያለውን እንደ ስፔኩለም (ብልት ውስጥ ለማየት ጥቅም ላይ የሚውል የብረት መሳሪያ) የሴቶች የማህጸን ምርመራዎች ላይ የሚውሉ የተለመዱ መሳሪያዎችን ስለሚጠቀም ነው።

English: They also found that combining different methods often gave doctors more information about a woman’s risk for getting cancer, especially over multiple check-ups.
Luganda: Era baakizuula ng’okugatta enkola ez’enjawulo kyawanga abasawo obubaka obusingawo obukwata ku bulabe bw’omukazi obw’okufuna kookolo w’omumwa gwa nnabaana, naddala nga bakebeddwa emirundi egiwera.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún ri pé àlòpọ̀ oríṣiríṣi ì̀gbésẹ̀ máa ń sábà fún àwọn dọ́kítà ní àlàyé tó kún si lórí ewu tí obìnrin wà láti ní àrùn jẹjẹrẹ, àgàgà lẹ́yìn ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àyẹ̀wò.
Zulu: Baphinde bathola ukuthi ukuhlanganisa izindlela ezahlukene kuvame ukunikeza odokotela ulwazi olwengeziwe mayelana nengozi yowesifazane yokuthola umdlavuza, ikakhulukazi ngokuhlolwa kaningi.
Hausa: Haka nan kuma sun gano cewa haɗa hanyoyin daban-daban sau da yawa yana bai wa likitoci ƙarin bayanai game da haɗarin da mace ke da shi na kamuwa da cutar kansa, musamman ma ta duba da yawa.
Northern Sotho: Ba hweditše le gore go kopanya mekgwa ye e fapafapanego gantši go thuša dingaka ka tshedimošo ye ntši mabapi le kotsi ya mosadi ya go fetelwa ke kankere, kudukudu go ditlhahlobo tša go fapafapana.
Amharic: አብዛኛውን ጊዜ የተለያዩ ዘዴዎችን መጠቀም በተለይም በተደጋጋሚ ምርመራዎች ሴቶች ካንሰር ለመያዝ ስላለቸው አደጋ ለዶክተሮች ተጨማሪ መረጃዎችን እንደሰጣቸው አግኝተዋል።

English: In addition, the researchers found that older women, especially those with HIV, were more likely to be diagnosed with cancer, so screening them often could be especially important.
Luganda: Ekirala, abanoonyereza baakizuula abakazi abakulu, naddala abo abalina HIV, be baali basinga okusuubirwa okusangibwa ne kookolo, noolwekyo okubakebera emirundi emingi kikulu nnyo.
Yoruba: Ní àfikún, àwọn aṣèwádìí náà ri pé àwọn àgbà obìnrin, àgàgà àwọn tí wọ́n ní HIV, tún lè ní èsì ìdámọ̀ àìsàn jẹjẹrẹ, nítorí èyí ṣíṣe àyẹ̀wò fún wọn lóòrèkóòrè ṣe pàtàkì.
Zulu: Ngaphezu kwalokho, abacwaningi bathole ukuthi abesifazane asebekhulile, ikakhulukazi labo abane-HIV, maningi amathuba okuba batholakale benomdlavuza, ngakho ukubahlola ngokuvamile kungabaluleka kakhulu.
Hausa: Bugu da ƙari, masu binciken sun gano cewa tsofaffin mata, musamman masu ɗauke da cutar HIV, sun fi kamuwa da cutar kansa, don haka, a lokuta da dama yin gwajinsu yana iya zama muhimmi.
Northern Sotho: Go feta fao, banyakišiši ba hweditše gore basadi ba bagolo, kudukudu bao ba nago le HIV, ba be ba le kotsing ye kgolo ya gore ba ka hwetšwa ba na le kankere ge ba phekolwa, ka gona go ba hlahloba gantši go ka ba bohlokwa kudu.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም፣ ተመራማሪዎቹ በተለይም ኤችአይቪ ያለባቸው በእድሜ የገፉ ሴቶች በካንሰር የመያዝ እድላቸው እጅግ ከፍተኛ እንደሆነ አግኝተዋል።

English: The researchers added that very few of the women were tested for HPV (before looking for lesions) even though a test exists.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baayongerako nti abakazi batono nnyo abaakeberwa HPV (nga tebannanoonya biwundu) newankubadde ng’enkola y’okukebera kino weeri.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣewádìí náà ṣe àfikún pé díẹ̀ lára àwọn obìnrin náà ni wọ́n ṣe àyẹ̀wò fún HPV (kí wọ́n tó wá egbò) bó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé àyẹ̀wò wà.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bengeze ngokuthi bambalwa kakhulu abesifazane abahlolelwa i-HPV (ngaphambi kokubheka izilonda) nakuba ukuhlolwa kukhona.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ƙara da cewa kaɗan ne daga cikin matan da aka yi wa gwajin cutar HPV (kafin neman raunuka) duk da cewa akwai gwaji.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba tlaleleditše ka gore ke palo ye nnyane kudu ya basadi ba ba dirilwego diteko tša HPV (pele go nyakanwa le mabadi) le ge e le gore diteko di gona.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በተጨማሪ ምርመራዎቹን ማግኘት ቢቻልም በጣም ጥቂት ሴቶች ለኤችፒቪ (ሊዬዞኖችን ከመፈለጋቸው በፊት) እንደተመረመሩ ተናግረዋል።

English: Doing so could be an important way of finding the disease even sooner.
Luganda: Okukola kino eyinza okuba engeri ennungi ey’okuzuula amangu obulwadde buno.
Yoruba: Ṣíṣe èyí lè jẹ́ ọ̀nà pàtàkì kan láti tún tètè rí àìsàn náà.
Zulu: Ukwenza kanjalo kungaba yindlela ebalulekile yokuthola lesi sifo ngokushesha.
Hausa: Yin hakan yana iya zama muhimmiyar hanyar gano cutar ko da wuri.
Northern Sotho: Go dira bjalo e ka ba tsela ye bohlokwa ya go lemoga bolwetši e sa le ka pela.
Amharic: ይህን ማድረግ በሽታውን በጣም በቶሎ ለማግኘት አስፈላጊ መንገድ ሊሆን ይችላል።

English: Overall, they said their results showed there was a need for the healthcare system in Namibia to plan HPV and cervical cancer prevention strategies more thoughtfully, using cheap, effective testing methods to find these diseases as early as possible.
